fato_historico: 1997: Korean Air Flight 801 crashed at Nimitz Hill, Guam, killing 229 of the 254 people on board.
energia_do_dia: Today, consider how resilience shapes your spirit. Just as the winds change near the peaks of Guam, your journey may face unexpected turbulence. Take a moment to ground yourself in gratitude and safety. It is a good time to reflect on the fragility of life and the strength found in moving forward with a compassionate, steady heart.
frase_do_dia: Every step you take honors the light you carry within your soul today.
significado_numero: Represents the infinite flow of abundance and cosmic balance.
conselho: Prioritize your peace and hold your loved ones a little closer today.
